classification: indicative public retail/reseller budget comparison; not a Beckhoff factory/project quotation

working_case.scope: two PoF boxes per rack; each 8 voltage readings + 8 two-wire RTDs + one box enable

single_Opta_per_rack_alternative.note: One CPU plus three eight-channel expansion modules can cover 16 V +16 RTD inputs under the two-wire RTD assumption; two CPU/module pairs are cheaper at these single-unit prices.

team_presentation_case.scope: Two boxes per rack; each up to 7 voltage readings + one two-wire RTD + one box enable. The source reports 4–7 V and one chassis RTD; costed at its upper voltage count.
team_presentation_case.note: Smaller scope than the user 8 V +8 T per-box sizing; do not compare this BOM to the larger Beckhoff BOM.

technical_basis: Arduino datasheet p.5–6 confirms eight programmable input channels and two-wire PT100 RTDs on all eight; Opta base supplies eight voltage inputs and four relay outputs. Beckhoff output is 24 V solid state; confirm the common box-enable electrical interface.
assumptions: Existing Beckhoff PLC/OPC UA platform reused at zero additional CPU cost.
Remote EtherCAT connection/station already in scope; spare capacity is not qualified here.
8 voltage +8 temperature channels are user working scope, not the smaller team presentation scope.
excluded: couplers, end terminals and extra station power if needed
sensors, connectors, cables and signal conditioning
engineering, software validation and long-term support

source_presentation.slides: 1–3: monitoring scope, work in progress and two-box Opta arrangement
